PHGE.description: Pushover Hinge Properties (PHGE). Assigns a pushover hinge to an object; TYPE selects which element category (BEAM/WALL/TRUSS/G-LINK/P-SPRING) the hinge applies to, HINGE_TYPE references a defined pushover hinge type by name, and FIBER_KEY links an optional fiber definition.

ID.description: Element type index of the assignment (1-based ordinal of TYPE among BEAM/WALL/TRUSS/G-LINK/P-SPRING). Used as the sub-key together with the object key.

TYPE.description: Element category the pushover hinge is assigned to. Determines the internal type index. Case-insensitive.

HINGE_TYPE.description: Name of the pushover hinge type (PHGT) to assign. Must reference an existing hinge type name; a non-existent name is rejected at runtime.

FIBER_KEY.description: Key of the associated fiber definition (0 when no fiber is used).
